name: limoncontrol-backend
description: API de LimonControl - gestion de venta de limones (POS, inventario, clientes, reportes)

scripts.db:init: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const fs=require('fs'); const mysql=require('mysql2/promise'); (async()=>{ const conn = await mysql.createConnection({host:process.env.DB_HOST||'localhost', port:Number(process.env.DB_PORT||3306), user:process.env.DB_USER||'root', password:process.env.DB_PASSWORD||'', multipleStatements:true}); const sql = fs.readFileSync('./schema.sql','utf8'); await conn.query(sql); console.log('Base de datos y tablas creadas correctamente.'); await conn.end(); })().catch(e=>{console.error(e); process.exit(1);});"
